prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Open Graph social preview card for a fictional Vietnamese milk tea ecommerce website
Primary request: create a polished landscape social card for the fictional brand Trà Sữa Ngon, with a single irresistible unbranded brown-sugar pearl milk tea product shot and a refined typographic brand lockup
Scene/backdrop: warm off-white editorial background with a deep jade-green geometric counter block, tiny restrained tapioca-dot pattern, and one subtle mandarin orange accent
Subject: one clear cup of creamy brown-sugar pearl milk tea, glossy black pearls and gentle condensation, positioned on the right half
Style/medium: premium commercial food photography integrated with clean modern Vietnamese editorial graphic design; friendly handcrafted modern identity; not a real brand
Composition/framing: exact target aspect 1200x630 landscape (approximately 1.9048:1); text occupies the left half with generous safe margins; drink occupies the right half; simple high-contrast hierarchy; nothing near crop edges
Lighting/mood: soft warm studio daylight, fresh, approachable and contemporary
Color palette: deep jade green #174F42, warm off-white #FBF8EF, mandarin orange #F25C1B, milk-tea caramel, black pearls
Text (verbatim): "Trà Sữa Ngon" and "Trà tươi mỗi ngày, ngon theo cách bạn chọn"
Typography: exact Vietnamese diacritics, large bold rounded editorial sans for the brand name, smaller clean readable sans for the tagline; only these two text lines/blocks, no other words
Constraints: render both Vietnamese text strings exactly and fully readable; no extra text, no logo symbol, no label on cup, no watermark, no website URL, no price, no claims beyond the supplied tagline, no real brand resemblance
Avoid: purple, gradients, glassmorphism, heavy shadows, clutter, three-card layouts, tiny type, misspelled Vietnamese, fake badges, floating ingredients, distorted cup, generic AI-tech aesthetic
